title: HHHusher button
description: A 5px-cornered button with a bold mono capital label. Solid is signal yellow and empties to a yellow outline on hover; glass is a see-through tile for dark backdrops that turns into a cream outline; link is a bare label with a small arrow that dims to 70%. Colours ease over 0.3s.
notes: glass is meant for dark sections (cream at 15%)
exports hhhusherLabel and hhhusherEase class strings for the site's other blocks
name: hhhusher-button

props.name: children
props.description: the label, set in the mono face in capitals

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
solid: yellow fill that empties to a yellow outline on hover · glass: a see-through tile
(cream at 15% on dark) that turns into an outline on hover · link: a bare label with an
arrow that dims on hover

props.name: size
props.description: sm: the 32px header size · md: the 43px size used in sections · lg: the 56px checkout size

props.name: arrow
props.description: add the small arrow after the label (link variant shows it by default)

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link
